item.title: Kasthall x Barber Osgerby: New rugs shaped by the loom | Home Accents Today
item.description: Swedish rug company Kasthall has collaborated with design studio Barber Osgerby to create two new rug collections: Atlas and Bon Bon.

item.title: How shifts in good/better/best categories for top of bed are emerging | Home Accents Today
item.description: Bedding brands report shifts in good, better, and best categories as consumers invest in layered, design-forward beds with a focus on quality and customization.

item.title: HiEnd Accents bets on depth, not trends, at High Point Market | Home Accents Today
item.description: HiEnd Accents will expand its coastal, modern contemporary menswear-inspired bedding collections and new introductions at next month's High Point Market in Showplace #2500.

item.title: New & Noteworthy: Put it in neutral | Home Accents Today
item.description: Five clean, neutral furnishings designed to mix in, that will be on display at next month's High Point Market.

item.title: HPMA sets April 10 registration deadline for badges to be mailed | Home Accents Today
item.description: The High Point Market Authority requires U.S. guests to register by April 10 for mailed Spring Market badges. International guests must register by March 27.

item.title: Century Furniture debuts new curated furniture collection this spring | Home Accents Today
item.description: At the upcoming High Point Market, Century will debut Symphony, a new case goods collection, and Century Lighting, a new product category.

item.title: Scroll, discover, buy: The TikTok Shop playbook for retailers | Home Accents Today
item.description: The TikTok Shop is not to be feared and instead should be embraced by brands and retailers everywhere, Jack Ahmadi of Prestige Brands says.

item.title: Williams-Sonoma announces promotion; Sherrill names new director | Who's News | Home Accents Today
item.description: Arteriors and Ultrafabrics also welcome two new additions.

item.title: Nate Berkus has new soft home partnership with Beco | Home Accents Today
item.description: Nate Berkus teams up with Beco Home to launch a soft home essentials collection debuting at New York Home Fashions Market in Q4 2026.

item.title: Container spot rates rise on trans-Pacific routes amid Iran conflict | Home Accents Today
item.description: Drewry index climbs for third week as trans-Pacific rates increase and carriers add fuel surcharges tied to Strait of Hormuz disruptions.
